title: Daily Challenges
description: A fun and engaging app where you complete daily missions to earn coins, track streaks, and challenge yourself every day.
how_to_play:
1. View the list of daily missions.
2. Check off missions as you complete them.
3. Claim rewards when all missions are completed.
4. Add, edit, or delete missions to customize your daily challenges.
5. Shuffle missions for variety.
6. Track your coin total and streak progress.

Tips:
- Complete all missions to maximize your daily reward.
- Keep a steady streak to earn bonus satisfaction.
- Customize your missions to suit your goals.
